style.vernacular: Polar research-station village on ice-free gravel at the Fildes Peninsula, King George Island: small prefabricated modular buildings (fourteen houses of about 90 m2) raised on the ground, clad in metal panels and painted in bright primary colours against snow, with low-pitched metal roofs, a gymnasium, a hospital module, a post office and a chapel made from a modified metal container. Beside it stand Russian, Chinese and Chilean station buildings. No trees; ground is dark gravel and snow.
style.ornament: Almost none: bold colour-blocked module walls, flag poles, satellite dishes and radio masts, and the Russian church's carved log and tent-roof form.

sources.what: 14 homes of 90 m2, school, air-force hospital, gymnasium, post office, chapel, marine tundra climate (mean -2.3 C), at 10 m elevation
